query: What signals suggest an agent's tickets will take longer to resolve?

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: Category of incident (email, vpn, database) is knowable at intake and plausibly correlates with how long resolution takes; genuine predictor outside the focus.

per_column.name: incident_symptom_type
per_column.rationale: Symptom (connection_failure, outage, access_denied) is available up front and carries signal about complexity/duration without restating the outcome.

per_column.name: scope_indicator
per_column.rationale: Blast radius (individual vs server-wide vs department) is a strong, legitimately pre-outcome driver of effort and time.

per_column.name: problem_specificity
per_column.rationale: How specific/diagnosable the problem is at intake plausibly predicts resolution effort; derived from description, not from the outcome.

per_column.name: remote_access_context
per_column.rationale: Whether the issue involves remote access is knowable early and could affect diagnosis/resolution difficulty.

per_column.name: assigned_agent
per_column.rationale: Agent identity is exactly the entity the query is about; agent-level speed differences are a core predictive signal for resolution time.

per_column.name: reassignment_indicator
per_column.rationale: Reassignment typically occurs during the ticket lifecycle and both causes and reflects longer handling; it is largely determined jointly with the resolution process, so it leaks the outcome rather than serving as a clean pre-resolution predictor.

per_column.name: ticket_open_status
per_column.rationale: Whether the ticket is still open is directly tied to whether/when it was resolved; for unresolved tickets resolution_time is undefined, making this a restatement/leak of the outcome status.

per_column.name: opened_day_of_week
per_column.rationale: Day opened (weekend vs weekday) is fixed at intake and can affect staffing/queue delays; legitimate temporal predictor.

per_column.name: opened_hour_of_day
per_column.rationale: After-hours vs business-hours opening is known at intake and plausibly affects time to first response and resolution.

judge.rationale: Most added columns are intake-time attributes (category, symptom, scope, specificity, remote context, agent, temporal features) that lie outside resolution_time and carry plausible predictive signal, adding real leverage beyond the raw fields. Two columns—reassignment_indicator and ticket_open_status—are contaminated by the lifecycle/outcome and constitute leakage. As a set the features provide substantial, non-mechanical predictive value, discounted for the leaky pair.
